rationale: LSCC has gapped up 12% on strong earnings news and is now consolidating mid-range (~67.7% of today's range) with the last 5 candles showing a pullback from the session high of $110 down to ~$107.33, suggesting the initial momentum is fading but no clear directional setup has emerged.
